name: Blackfathom Camp
summary: Blackfathom Camp is a small Alliance outpost tucked away in the northwestern forests of Ashenvale. Led by Talen, the camp sits between the Horde-held Zoram'gar Outpost and the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. It serves as a forward staging ground for Alliance travelers keeping watch over the nearby coast.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: Perched on the bluffs southeast of the entrance to Blackfathom Deeps, this humble campsite gives Alliance scouts an eye on both the ancient coastal temple and the nearby Horde outpost of Zoram'gar. Led on the ground by Talen, the camp provides weary adventurers with a brief respite in the contested wildlands of Ashenvale, where cultists, naga, and Warsong raiders all vie for control.

faq.answer: Blackfathom Camp is a small Alliance campsite situated on the northwest coast of Ashenvale. It acts as a forward lookout near Blackfathom Deeps and keeps tabs on the nearby Horde post at Zoram'gar Outpost.
The camp is under the watch of Talen, who oversees the small outpost and coordinates Alliance efforts in the area.

faq.q: Why is this camp so close to Zoram'gar Outpost?
faq.answer: The coastline of the Zoram Strand is a hotly contested front in Ashenvale. The camp sits in a precarious position, allowing the Alliance to monitor Horde maneuvers coming out of Zoram'gar Outpost while investigating the corruption radiating from the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: For Alliance forces delving into the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps or patrolling the hostile Zoram Strand, this small camp serves as the closest safe haven in the northwestern woods.
Situated just up the coast from Zoram'gar Outpost, this camp represents a persistent Alliance presence watching your movements along the strand.
